harnessText:
"""Round-3 rule-6 mutants for syzygy-bpyt.6.1: round 2's twelve, read from its record, plus six for the round-3 repair.

Each mutant replaces one exact fragment (it must occur exactly once), runs the recorded command, restores the bytes and verifies their
digest. Killed: at least one test failed. Usage: python3 mutants.py <worktree> <out.json>
"""
import hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT, OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
SUBJECT = 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/code-structure.ts'
COMMAND = ['npx', 'vitest', 'run', 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/code-structure.test.ts', 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/model.test.ts']
ROUND2 = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/evidence/code-structure-ls-tree-z-mutants-2026-10-21-r2.json').read_text())
KEEP_IF_NOT_GITLINK = 'if (!record.subarray(0, GITLINK_RECORD.length).equals(GITLINK_RECORD)) kept.push(record);'
MUTANTS = [(m['id'], m['file'], m['old'], m['new']) for m in ROUND2['mutants']] + [
    ('gitlink-filter-off', SUBJECT, 'return STRICT_UTF8.decode(withoutGitlinkRecords(bytes));', 'return STRICT_UTF8.decode(bytes);'),
    ('gitlink-filter-keeps-every-record', SUBJECT, KEEP_IF_NOT_GITLINK, 'kept.push(record);'),
    ('gitlink-filter-inverted', SUBJECT, KEEP_IF_NOT_GITLINK, 'if (record.subarray(0, GITLINK_RECORD.length).equals(GITLINK_RECORD)) kept.push(record);'),
    ('unterminated-tail-dropped', SUBJECT, '  if (start < bytes.length) kept.push(bytes.subarray(start));\n', ''),
    ('parse-gitlinks-from-any-runner', SUBJECT, "parseGitLsTree(raw.split('\\0').filter((record) => !record.startsWith('160000 ')).join('\\0'))", 'parseGitLsTree(raw)'),
    ('every-throw-is-non-utf8', SUBJECT, 'if (error instanceof NonUtf8GitOutput) {', 'if (error instanceof Error) {'),
]

sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
git = lambda *args: subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout

def run_suite():
    proc = subprocess.run(COMMAND, cwd=ROOT, env={**os.environ, 'CI': '1'}, capture_output=True)
    text = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', (proc.stdout + proc.stderr).decode('utf8', 'replace'))
    tests = next((line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('Tests ')), None)
    failed = sorted({line.strip()[2:].strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('× ')})
    return proc.returncode, tests, failed

files = sorted({m[1] for m in MUTANTS})
originals = {f: (ROOT / f).read_bytes() for f in files}
clean_before = git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == ''
base_exit, base_tests, base_failed = run_suite()
results = []
try:
    for mutant_id, path, old, new in MUTANTS:
        text = originals[path].decode('utf8')
        assert text.count(old) == 1, (mutant_id, old)
        (ROOT / path).write_bytes(text.replace(old, new).encode('utf8'))
        try:
            code, tests, failed = run_suite()
        finally:
            (ROOT / path).write_bytes(originals[path])
        results.append({'id': mutant_id, 'file': path, 'old': old, 'new': new, 'exitCode': code, 'testsLine': tests, 'failedTests': failed,
                        'outcome': 'killed' if code != 0 and failed else 'survived', 'restored': sha((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == sha(originals[path])})
        print(mutant_id, results[-1]['outcome'], tests, flush=True)
finally:
    for path in files:
        (ROOT / path).write_bytes(originals[path])
record = {
    'subject': files, 'subjectSha256': {f: sha(originals[f]) for f in files}, 'bead': 'syzygy-bpyt.6.1', 'round': 3,
    'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(), 'command': ' '.join(COMMAND), 'trackedTreeCleanBefore': clean_before,
    'unmutated': {'exitCode': base_exit, 'testsLine': base_tests, 'failedTests': base_failed},
    'mutants': results, 'trackedTreeCleanAfter': git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == '',
    'summary': {'planned': len(MUTANTS), 'killed': sum(r['outcome'] == 'killed' for r in results)},
    'harnessText': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print('summary', record['summary'])

A first run at 41225e4a left gitlinks-admitted (drop the blob filter) surviving, because no test fed a non-blob record that reaches the filter once gitlinks are dropped before parsing; eddf9677 adds a tree-record check and this run kills all eighteen.
